narrative.summary: Root owner resolves to a bare EOA two hops down; the real 7-day timelock never covers setOwner / setCurator / setIsSentinel. Shares its curator Safe with the Ethena x Steakhouse vault.
narrative.detail: curator() is a real 3-of-7 Safe, and isSentinel() is true for a 1-of-7 Safe sharing the same seven owners - but owner() points through an 8,609-byte contract to a bare EOA two hops down. Per-function timelocks are real (604,800s / 7 days) on addAdapter / removeAdapter / cap changes, but setOwner, setCurator, setIsSentinel and decreaseAbsoluteCap all resolve to 0. A curator/sentinel layer that looks like real multisig protection sits behind a root that isn’t multisig-protected at all. Its curator Safe's all 7 owners are shared with the Morpho Ethena x Steakhouse USDG vault (batch 7 crossExposureScore: 80/100) - the only overlap found across all 15 tracked signer groups.
